title: [4K] I visited KTX Busan Station and Busan Eurasia Platform / train to busan
description:
I visited KTX Busan Station and Busan Eurasia Platform (formerly Busan Station Plaza) under development in connection with Busan's North Port Redevelopment.

I like walking and traveling. There are various videos of traveling all over Korea on this channel. 
Pressing subscription and like and setting an alarm is very helpful for video production. I beg you.
